description: This Java source file defines the LogWrapper class, which wraps Android's native Log utility to implement the LogNode interface, facilitating logging with chaining support within an Android application.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface to support chained logging.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain to receive log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message with the specified priority, tag, and optional Throwable; forwards log data to the next node if available.
